title: Deep Reactive Observable Store with Change Listeners
problemStatement: Implement `createObservable(initialState, onChange)` that returns a deeply reactive proxy. Whenever any property at any depth is modified or added, `onChange({ path, oldValue, newValue })` must be synchronously triggered. Nested objects accessed or modified must also be reactive.
interviewTrap: Shallow proxies fail to notify mutations on nested properties (e.g., store.user.profile.name = 'Alex'). Recursively wrapping targets on get and preserving object identity via WeakMap is essential.

testCases.name: Triggers on top-level property mutation
testCases.testFn: let change = null; const store = createObservable({ count: 0 }, c => change = c); store.count = 1; return change;

testCases.name: Triggers on deeply nested mutation with exact dot path
testCases.testFn: let log = ''; const store = createObservable({ user: { profile: { city: 'Paris' } } }, c => log = c.path + ':' + c.newValue); store.user.profile.city = 'Tokyo'; return log;

testCases.name: Does not trigger listener when setting identical value
testCases.testFn: let calls = 0; const store = createObservable({ val: 42 }, () => calls++); store.val = 42; return calls;
